integrity: The proof independently establishes the ideal-decoding survival law from recovery completeness, reduces it to a marked Poisson random-graph tree law, and derives the limiting integral. A standard-library verifier checks the exact finite-dimension integrated formula and the stated KKT optimum.
scientific_limitations: The theorem uses the iterated large-multiplicity then large-dimension regime, positive limiting weight-\(1\) mass \(a\in(0,1)\), and fields large enough for the recovery-complete construction. It does not give finite-\(x\) error rates, cover the boundary \(a=0\), or extend automatically to supports of weight at least \(3\).
title: The ideal-decoding degree-\(2\) random-access conjecture has the LT limit
